name: search_seq_including_spaces
desc: Standard-library Python CLI for DNA and protein sequences: finds patterns whose front and back are fixed while the spacer in between varies, and writes CSV/JSONL. Also reads FASTA/FASTQ/GenBank, compares and translates sequences, gives RNA-fold and protein hints, and fetches from NCBI/PDB. CI-tested on Python 3.10–3.14.

name: Aoi
desc: Baseball (NPB) research framework that looks for better questions rather than answers: starting from unexplained long-term outcomes, it observes, measures and tests the limits of models, metrics and evaluation. Parent of the six research subprojects below (git subtree).

name: QueRyu
desc: Reproducible, polite fetching of NPB pages with conditional-GET caching and provenance, used to build observation datasets for Aoi.

name: BlueProbe
desc: Observes and extracts the HTML/CSS/DOM structure of NPB pages before any interpretation (observe first, interpret later).

name: SakAnalytics
desc: Team-season metrics, remaining-game and clinch magic-number simulation, and synthetic-league experiments from NPB game records.

name: PythDRagoras
desc: Treats explanations as propositions and tests them against counterexamples, with rule search and sensitivity analysis for NPB outcomes.

name: DRAgoWing
desc: Renders research records as Plotly.js HTML reports and proposition tables, with optional headless-Chrome PNG/SVG export and no Python plotting libraries.

name: NagoyAction
desc: Defines a research pipeline once in TOML and runs it with the same standard-library command locally and on GitHub Actions, with run receipts, Markdown link checks and publication gates.

name: gh_identity
desc: Single-file, standard-library Python interface over the GitHub CLI for observing repositories, pull requests, checks and workflow runs, with explicit identity and bounded output.

name: xprobe
desc: Single-file, standard-library toolkit for text search, boundary-case probing and failure-oriented test support, including convention-driven discovery of files and production symbols.

name: yourself
desc: Single-file, standard-library tool that reports host, OS and runtime facts read-only, as concise copyable text for troubleshooting and AI context.

name: cli_args
desc: Single-file, standard-library toolkit for reusable CLI argument definitions, validation, command construction, execution and JSON/text output.

name: markdown
desc: Lightweight, function-focused Markdown utilities built with the Python standard library only.

name: ascii_artist
desc: Python utilities for ASCII art generation, conversion, layout and text-based diagrams. CI-tested on Python 3.10–3.14.

name: Err-o-RoadRunner
desc: Error-triggered triage for Python, Node and CI failures: does nothing until something fails, then prints FOUND / NOT FOUND / HINT reports. Python standard library only.

name: nvd_nist_known_vulns
desc: Single-file, standard-library client for the NVD CVE API 2.0: fetches known vulnerabilities for CPE 2.3 names and emits deterministic JSON Lines. CI-tested on Python 3.9–3.14.

media.alt: CPE inputs pass through NVD CVE API queries and CVSS processing to JSONL output, with offline tests and CI evidence.

run.output:
usage: nvd_nist_known_vulns.py [-h] [--silent] [--config CONFIG] [--cpe CPES]
                               [--output OUTPUT] [--timeout SECONDS]
                               [--format {text,json}]
                               [--cvss-v3-severity {LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL}]
                               [--cvss-v3-metrics CVSS_V3_METRICS]

Fetch known CVEs from the NVD CVE API 2.0 for CPE 2.3 names and write nvd-cve-summary/1 JSONL.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --silent              Do not print per-CPE progress lines on stderr. Errors
                        are still reported.
  --config CONFIG       UTF-8 INI file with a [cpeName] section, used only
                        when --cpe is omitted. Default: config.ini. A missing,
                        unreadable, invalid, or empty CPE list exits 2.
  --cpe CPES            One CPE 2.3 name to query. Repeat for multiple names.
                        Values are not split on commas. When any --cpe is
                        present, --config is not read.
  --output OUTPUT       Write JSONL to this UTF-8 path, replacing it only
                        after a finished run. Default: stdout. A failed run
                        leaves an existing file unchanged. An output path that
                        cannot be published exits 1.
  --timeout SECONDS     Positive finite per-request socket timeout in seconds.
                        Default: 30.
  --format {text,json}  Failure report on stderr. text (default) prints error:
                        lines for input and runtime failures. json prints one
                        nvd-cli-error/1 object and no progress lines. Success
                        output is always JSONL.
  --cvss-v3-severity {LOW,MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL}
                        Optional NVD cvssV3Severity filter on CVE API 2.0:
                        LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or CRITICAL. Filtered output uses
                        filtered_cve records.
  --cvss-v3-metrics CVSS_V3_METRICS
                        Optional NVD cvssV3Metrics filter: a partial or full
                        CVSS v3 vector. Blank values are rejected. The value
                        is trimmed and uppercased.

exit status:
  0  success, including a CPE query that returns zero CVEs
  1  the NVD request failed, or --output could not be published
  2  usage or local input error (flags, config file, or CPE list)

--format json writes one nvd-cli-error/1 object to stderr on failure and
omits progress lines. Success records stay JSONL on stdout or --output.
--format text (the default) writes error: lines for input and runtime
failures. Flag mistakes also include the usage summary.

name: BrowserTestKit
desc: Cross-browser testing reference kit: Playwright Node and Python lanes on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit (desktop and mobile), screenshot evidence and OS/browser matrices on GitHub Actions, plus standard-library engineering utilities.

name: PySaiyanWeBoo
desc: Shared, build-free CSS themes, UI components and small JavaScript utilities for the static pages of these projects, including layout presets that switch without reloading.

name: flutter_navigation_basic
desc: Multi-platform Flutter app (Web, iOS, Android, macOS) with 198 routed screens on a reusable foundation (themes, routes, shared widgets, URL parameters); the Flutter Web build is published on GitHub Pages and checked with Playwright screenshots.

name: mcp-toolcall-lab
desc: Reproducible experiments on how LLMs discover and call MCP tools: a FastMCP server with deterministic mock tools, Open WebUI and LibreChat as clients under test, protocol tests and an anti-pattern catalog.

name: Ironmate
desc: Python toolkit for converting documents and images: a Markdown-to-PPTX pipeline, text and color editing of existing PPTX, browser-based Image Studio and Slide Studio, and pixel-grid art prototypes.

name: TalkCompress
desc: Experiments in short expressions that keep their meaning for a given reader: which shared knowledge or rules make them understandable. Measures characters, UTF-8 bytes and LLM tokens across shared machine-to-machine rulebooks, human-readable shorthand and multilingual layers.
